scope: Exact reviewed native PKG installer, download completion and console notification contracts. Source text only; no console contact, install, payload execution or archive writes.

localPackageInstall.ps4Semantics: InstallLocalPkg validates PKG magic/title, starts a BGFT task and loops until reported transferred length reaches total or an error. The HTTP result is still the native service's report, not independent application verification.
localPackageInstall.ps4ReplacementBehavior: BGFT registration errors 0x80990088 or 0x80990015 cause the native client to uninstall the existing title and retry registration. The helper must warn and require explicit reviewed-package consent; never trigger this automatically on open or after download.
localPackageInstall.ps5Semantics: The local-file overload passes remove_after_install=false, calls Direct Package Installer and returns success after acceptance. It does not wait for final installation and does not remove the original PKG. Compatible DPI must already be running.
localPackageInstall.safeIntegration: Install an authored helper at the matching native client origin. Opening it with a selected path makes no request. Explicitly verify the exact saved regular-file entry and expected size with /__local__/list, refuse a matching .tmp, require consent, then recheck metadata and send one exact items entry. Preserve a durable request guard even after an accepted result until the user reviews the console outcome.
limits: A metadata listing cannot verify a file's full SHA-256, signature, content ID, firmware compatibility or free space.
Native file metadata checks are not atomic locks against another process changing contents.
PS4 installation may block its request for a long time. A timeout does not prove the native operation stopped.
PS5 Direct Package Installer has its own native prerequisites; do not send arbitrary TCP probes or claim ezRemote starts it automatically.

savedPathContract.evidence: PS4 local-file overload reads the given path and maps /data to /user/data for BGFT. The PS5 overload explicitly permits /data, /user/data and /mnt/usb prefixes, rejecting other roots. The helper uses a narrower data-or-single-digit-USB contract for both platforms.
savedPathContract.verification: Exact parent listing and regular-file name/size check, no matching .tmp. USB index is a native mount name, never a physical-port claim. Existing metadata does not prove mounted/writable state, free space, or hash integrity.

installFromURL.notes: Both pinned clients parse these fields. PS5 explicitly checks Direct Package Installer before continuing. This route is a separate native installation workflow, not a file-save queue. It is intentionally not used by the authored local-PKG helper. No debrid credentials or arbitrary URL proxy are added.

completionAndOSNotification.automaticNativePS4: The background worker calls Util::Notify with the destination path after its remote Get operation returns success and after attempting the temporary-to-final rename. Util::Notify uses sceKernelSendNotificationRequest.
completionAndOSNotification.automaticNativePS5: The background worker calls Util::RichNotify with the item id and destination path at the same stage. RichNotify uses sceNotificationSend. These are actual native OS calls rather than browser toasts.
completionAndOSNotification.importantLimit: Both workers ignore the return of FS::Rename before emitting completion and marking STATE_SUCCESS. State4 and the existing OS toast therefore mean receiver-reported completion, not verified final-path existence or file hash.
completionAndOSNotification.authoredUIToastRule: Do not toast completed from the POST acknowledgement. Wait for a matching path and completion record, then inspect actual destination existence/size and partial-file state where supported. Say receiver reports complete if that is all the evidence available. Keep failed and ambiguous states distinct and never auto-retry.
completionAndOSNotification.genericNotifyEndpoint: No generic HTTP notify/notification route was found in the reviewed ezRemote Client/Server or PS5 Payload Manager HTTP dispatchers. Do not invent /notify or a cross-origin bridge to it. Native notifications already belong to the running receiver.
completionAndOSNotification.brandingLimit: The receiver owns native notification wording and icon. Changing it would require a separately reviewed native server build; a web page cannot truthfully claim to customize the console OS notification by showing browser UI.

ps4RemotePackageInstaller.requirements: RPI must be installed and foregrounded while it receives commands. Package URLs must be reachable from the PS4; a PC loopback URL is not a console-reachable server. Compatible HEN/ShellCore/fPKG prerequisites remain required.
ps4RemotePackageInstaller.parserCaveat: The pinned progress handler prints some numeric fields as unquoted 0x hexadecimal literals, which are not standard JSON. Do not silently JSON.parse this output or evaluate it as code. A future adapter would need a bounded, field-specific non-executing parser preserving safe integer limits.
ps4RemotePackageInstaller.scopeDecision: The new helper uses the already-reviewed local ezRemote installer route rather than introducing RPI, new LAN exposure or a broad package-serving service. No uninstall, task-stop or task-remove operation is exposed.

ps5PayloadManager.purpose: Its repository install/upload APIs manage payloads. The reviewed dispatcher does not establish a generic PKG installation API. AUTO_INSTALL_APP relates to the manager's own app workflow, not permission to send any PKG to it.
ps5PayloadManager.decision: Keep payload management on8084 separate from native package installation through ezRemote/DPI.

authoredImplementation.archiveStatus: Prepared only; parent agent imports active and retained archive jobs before enabling final public links.

languages.method: Embed only exported UI keys and existing authored local-only adapter in each immutable helper; no remote scripts or expanded API origin.
languages.status: Final inline dictionaries generated and validated in both immutable helpers.
